high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals standing in what appears to be an office environment. The setting is characterized by open desks, office chairs, and various office supplies such as printers, tissue boxes, and files. The ceiling features exposed ductwork and lighting fixtures, contributing to the industrial look of the space. The person on the left is wearing a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves, dark blue jeans, and black sneakers with a white Nike swoosh. They have a red bracelet on their right wrist and are making a peace sign with both hands.
